title: The Extra Room
narration: My hotel room had a door that was missing from the floor plan. Behind it I found luggage, phones and photographs showing me watching previous guests sleep. Security footage showed I had checked in with a frightened woman I could not remember. Reception called to say my wife was waiting downstairs, although I was unmarried. Someone knocked at the main door. For several seconds I could hear nothing except my breathing and the small ordinary sounds around me. Every explanation I tried made the details worse, because each clue had been placed where I alone would find it. I wanted to leave immediately, but doing that would mean abandoning the only proof that any of this had happened. From the hidden room, another woman whispered, 'Don't believe her. I made that mistake last time.'
